I don't remember but from now on there must be strict safeguards about repeat betting on the same player or team or prop. figure out and implement strong safeguards so that bets and bids are diversified and not too much placed on one team or player. for my hand bets, if I already bet the same player or team or prop, give me the big red x in the bet slip just like the other bet slips have when the bets are not profitable in my history. 

also sometimes bets are no longer offered at the odds listed in the scanner and the betslip tells me. if this is the case, automatically remove these bets from the scanned list immediately
